summary: Webster Parish, LA tower on a ridge near Minden; NGS describes a 100-ft steel cab tower and a 1954 towerman item; no source found on its current state.

facts.design: Four-legged steel structure supporting a cab, overall height 100 feet
facts.status_note: No source we read says whether the tower still stands

events.note: Coast and Geodetic Survey first observed the station and described it; overall tower height 100 feet
Towerman Gus Nathanial White had been at the tower seven years; state-provided home across the road

notes_for_editor: Brief coordinates (32.6957, -93.2392) match the NGS mark. Build date, end of service and current condition are not in any source read; the story says so only in the 'today' paragraph. The 1950 NGS entry is an observation date, not a build date, and is logged as 'other'. Two searches run; no further Dutchtown history found.
